notes.title: Patch v1.1.1
notes.content:
Correction

 Fixed problem with player positions not loading.
 Fixes to some NPC hit detection

notes.title: v 1.1.0 リリース
notes.content:
Thank you very much for all the users who have been playing our game.

We have made some major changes to the menu screen!
We have also made other changes that will improve your gaming experience, so please give it a try!

[previewyoutube=RBTAcThQSeE;full][/previewyoutube]

Changes.

Additional Features 

 Major changes to menu screen UI
 Added volume setting screen
 Smoother lighting changes based on weather and time


Modifications

 Fixed problem with darker buildings and shadows in buildings
 fix to issue where some NPCs were not visible



Future roadmap.
(subject to change depending on development status)

v1.2.0 (subject to change depending on development status)

 Achievements added.
 Addition of Steam Cloud Save
 Added map functionality.


v1.3.0

 Implemented event hints
 Addition of tutorial screen
 Added mini-games.

notes.title: Patch v1.0.1
notes.content:
FIXES

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42564301/be280e2f2964a825ab6ac6d5ed113e8a912b9b61.png


 Added more types of player movement animations for more fluent switching.
 Added the ability to retrieve No. 51 cards.
 Player names are now reflected when talking to NPCs.
 Jump animations are now reflected.
 Mouse cursor icons have been changed to game-specific icons.
